ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FreeSnore uses the microphone to detect and analyse snoring while you sleep.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: FreeSnore uses your approximate location (about 10 km) to fetch pollen and weather data for your area and compare them with your snoring. Your location is not stored.
ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: FreeSnore reads data from your watch and scales (heart rate, blood oxygen, sleep stages, weight) to compare it with your snoring. It writes nothing to Health.
